Essence Pool: 75. Materialize: 60m. Willpower: 9 (12 temporary). Linguistics specialty: Body Language (universal communication). Poison [Aconite]: 6L/hour, speed 3M, -/-, -3. Spirit Charms: Harrow the Mind, Principle of Motion, Reserve of Will x3, Shapechange, Weaving of Flesh. First/Second/Third Excellencies: Athletics, Dodge, Melee, Presence, Stealth. Called by mingled tears of parents mixing with afterbirth of a stillborn baby.
system.biography: Demons of the First Circle. Humanoid female demons with pale lavender flesh, full sensual lips, large dark pupilless eyes, hairless bodies. The most sexually appealing beings to most species. Court-appointed courtesans who exchange services for flesh, weaving donated flesh into unique composite creatures.
